title: What can make a product successful

blocks.heading: What can make a product successful
blocks.text: Useful success features include meeting a real need, reliable quality, suitable design, value at the price, accessible supply and appropriate differentiation. Repeat purchases depend on the experience as well as awareness. A memorable brand can help recognition but cannot make a defective product reliable. Judge success against the business objective and customer group rather than assuming every product must be the cheapest or most technically advanced. Demand, cost and consistent delivery matter together.

blocks.heading: Putting the idea to work
blocks.text: Eha Lunch Boxes keeps food secure and is easy for its target workers to carry. Those features meet a practical need. An expensive decorative feature may contribute little if it prevents the target customers affording the box.
